method.regex: Hand-authored case-insensitive regex; matches name/description/body; boolean matches ordered newest created then handle. Patterns supplied beside every query.
method.semantic: Real production SemanticSearchService, explicitly selected dense mode (production default), warm local Ollama model; evaluation-only hybrid BM25+dense RRF comparator; no answer generation or reranking. Production embedQuery hook preserves model instructions. Each query embeds on every repetition.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank; single client sequential; first search includes index construction and one query.
method.memory: Node RSS sampled every 20ms during each model run. Ollama /api/ps model allocation reported separately; not total machine peak.
method.quality: Authored synthetic corpus and relevance judgments; quality is a smoke test, not an independent corpus benchmark.
